title: Two  | Autofarm | Max lvl in a hour
script:
local Material = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Kinlei/MaterialLua/master/Module.lua"))()
local Settings = {}

local UI = Material.Load({
     Title = "Kronos",
     Style = 1,
     SizeX = 400,
     SizeY = 250,
     Theme = "Dark"
})

local main = UI.New({Title = "Main"})
local mob_list = {}
for i,v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do 
    if v:IsA("Model") and v:FindFirstChild("NPC") and not table.find(mob_list, v.Name) then 
        table.insert(mob_list, v.Name)
    end
end

main.Dropdown({
    Text = "Select NPC",
    Options = mob_list,
    Callback = function(v)
        Settings["ChosenMob"] = v 
    end
})

main.Toggle({
    Text = "Autofarm",
    Enabled = false,
    Callback = function(v)
        Settings["Autofarm"] = v 
    end
})

spawn(function()
    while wait() do 
        if Settings.Autofarm then 
            pcall(function()
                if game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Combat") then 
                    game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.Humanoid:EquipTool(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Backpack:FindFirstChild("Combat")) 
                end
                
                for i,v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
                    if v:IsA("Model") and v.Name == Settings.ChosenMob then 
                        repeat wait() 
                            game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = v:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart").CFrame * CFrame.new(0,0,4)
                            workspace[game.Players.LocalPlayer.Name]:FindFirstChild("Combat").Attack.A1:FireServer(game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer)
                        until not Settings.Autofarm or v:FindFirstChild("Humanoid").Health <= 0
                    end
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end)
